author: Pierre-MarieMarchio
name: .NET Clean Architecture Web Package
description: One more internal package in the pnpm workspace src/Web of a project generated by cleanarch-webapi: source-exported, framework-agnostic TypeScript, with one exported function and its test. Run it at the project root.

scope.description: The workspace's package scope without the @, as in src/Web/package.json (for example acme-shop).

postActions.description: Record the package in the project.

manualInstructions.text: At the project root, run dotnet cleanarch add web-package --name <name>, which records the package in cleanarch.json.

postActions.description: Link the package into the workspace.

manualInstructions.text: Run pnpm install in src/Web, add "@<scope>/<name>": "workspace:*" to the dependencies of each app that uses it, and commit the lockfile with the package.
